trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account, so treat this one as the finish line rather than a task. Work the roadmap in order — story first, stranger strands before the finale, then collectibles and activities — and watch the seven missables flagged in this guide, because they are the only trophies that can force a second playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded automatically at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces Jason on the Leonida coast. There is nothing to prepare and no way to miss it: play through the prologue, learn the movement and cover basics, and the trophy lands as the mission wraps up.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story progression — finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks during the closing sequence. Chapters cannot be skipped or failed permanently, so if a set-piece keeps beating you, stock snacks and armour beforehand instead of hunting for a workaround.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 to earn this. The chapter widens the map and introduces Lucia's side of the story; greet any stranger introductions that appear along the way, because several side strands that matter later first become available during this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By now both protagonists' routines are open, so this is a good moment to start the collectible and activity grinds in parallel with the story instead of leaving everything for the endgame cleanup.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the last full chapter before the endgame stretch, so before pushing on, sweep up any open stranger strands — the missable finals in this guide are far easier to secure while the whole cast is still active.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission to unlock this gold. Go in with full health, armour, ammo and your best upgraded weapons; the finale is a long multi-stage set-piece. Important: several stranger strands close once the credits roll, so clear the missable finals listed in this guide before you start it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, a delivery-style mission early in Lucia's arc. Learn the route on a first attempt if you need to — missions can be replayed from the menu, and the trophy only needs one completion at any medal level.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the first big score of the campaign. Pick your crew and approach when prompted and play through to the escape; the trophy is for completion, not for a clean or undetected run, so do not restart over alarms or a messy getaway.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It leans on stealth sections where being spotted costs you time, not the trophy — completion is all that counts, so push through rather than reloading for a perfect run.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. Expect a vehicle-heavy chase sequence; a fast, durable car pulled from your own garage makes the middle section noticeably calmer. Completion at any performance level earns the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport operation. You fight across the airfield, so bring a scoped rifle for the open tarmac stretches. The trophy is completion-based and cannot be missed once the mission appears in the story flow.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, the swamp assault late in the campaign. Armour and a shotgun for the close-quarters sections help; like every story trophy here, it unlocks on completion regardless of deaths or checkpoint restarts along the way.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion tracker — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and hobbies all feed it. Use the game's own checklist under Stats to find what is missing instead of guessing, and leave this for last: most of the percentage arrives naturally while you earn everything else on the list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida. Stunts are marked on the map once discovered and each counts only once, so work region by region and let this tracker's counter keep score. A fast sports bike handles most ramps; if a jump keeps failing, take a longer run-up rather than a faster car.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once: races, fishing, arcade games, drone races, the shooting range and the rest of the hobby icons. You only need to start each type, not win it, so spend one evening touring the map's activity markers and this will pop along the way.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each weapon class has its own set, and medals are about score, not survival — replay a challenge until its target patterns are memorised. Accuracy bonuses beat raw speed on the later ranges, so ease off the trigger and chain hits instead of spraying.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. There is one course per district and the trophy needs a win at each, not a medal sweep. Learn each course with one practice run, then push — the rival drones are beatable once you know where the tight gates sit.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same event do not add to the tally, so keep moving to new race markers. Street races in a tuned sports car are the fastest route, and off-road events count too if you prefer them. The counter in this tracker mirrors the in-game stat.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the rival angler introduced through the fishing spots; upgrade your rod and bait at the tackle shop before challenging him, and take his challenge on a calm morning when the bigger fish bite — the win is what counts, not any single catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish, at a Leonida arcade. Pick the shortest cabinet first — a full clear of a simple game counts just as much as a long one, and using continues still counts as completing it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand, including his final mission. Andy's errands escalate across several meetings that unlock as the story advances, so complete each new Andy icon as it appears instead of batching them for later. His story is about second chances — and yours is used up if you leave this too late.
trophies.ponr: Andy's strand closes for good once the final story mission is completed. Finish his final mission before starting You Gotta Know When to Get Off.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand through to his final mission — the boat job the title is joking about. Kenton works around the marinas, so keep his meetings current as they unlock rather than letting them pile up behind the story.
trophies.ponr: Kenton's final mission is unavailable once the main story ends. Wrap his strand up before the final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Ride Billy's strand through to its final mission. Billy is the lone biker contact and his jobs lean on bike handling, so a motorcycle you are comfortable with makes the whole chain smoother.
trophies.ponr: Billy's final mission disappears once the final story mission is complete. Finish his strand before the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand is a character's whole chain of meetings, not a single errand — and the five missable finals in this guide all count toward the eight. New strands keep appearing as the story opens new districts, so this usually lands during Stage 2 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand and its supply-run finale. Randy's missions revolve around moving goods, so expect wanted-level escapes; a fast car stored nearby shortens every one of them.
trophies.ponr: Randy's final mission is cut off once the story ends. Complete his strand before starting the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's strand through his final mission. Tyrone's jobs unlock in stages tied to story progress, so if his icon vanishes for a while, advance the story and check back rather than assuming the strand is over.
trophies.ponr: Tyrone's strand cannot be finished after the final story mission. Do it before the endgame.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot scattered across Leonida — quiet viewpoints marked by small shrines once you get close. Each spot is a quick interaction, not a challenge, so the work is in finding them all; sweep them region by region alongside the other collectibles. PowerPyx flags this trophy as missable, so start the hunt early.
trophies.ponr: Per PowerPyx, some meditation spots become unreachable after late-story events reshape their areas. Begin collecting from Chapter 2 onward instead of leaving every spot for post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret's strand builds to a one-off hunt for a specific legendary creature; bring a scoped rifle and follow his clues instead of wandering the wetlands at random.
trophies.ponr: Bret's hunt is tied to his strand, which closes when the story ends. Finish it before the final mission.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide across Leonida in shops, bars and landmarks, and a set completes only when every card in it is found — so finish one set at a time instead of scattering pickups. Cards are never missable; they wait in the world after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo app at 100 marked locations — viewpoints and landmarks where the app prompts you to snap the scene. Locations register on the map as you pass them; combine the hunt with the stunt and card routes so the trips overlap, and keep this tracker's counter in step with the in-app one.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges — the rotating skill tasks listed in the pause menu, from driving feats to combat trials. You need 50, not all of them, so cherry-pick the ones that match how you already play and let the rest accumulate naturally.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while with your partner and escape. Build the wanted level together — crimes committed with both protagonists present — then break line of sight and hide until the heat dies; swapping vehicles and ducking into alleys or water speeds it up. Do not split up: the escape has to happen as a pair.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Plan a tight triangle of small stores, keep the car running outside each one and move fast — the chain breaks if the stars drop off or either of you is busted. Small convenience stores beat big malls here.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in and drive it. Traffic variety differs by district: downtown feeds you sports cars, the countryside gives trucks and off-roaders. Stealing parked cars in rich neighbourhoods fills the rare slots fastest.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Set it up deliberately: find a group of five or more hostiles, top up your Focus first, then trigger it in the open with a full magazine. Gang hideouts and the later heist escapes offer the densest crowds.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, steal an aircraft from Vice City International and take off without clearance. Wait for a plane on the apron, expect an instant wanted level, and lift off fast and low; a small private jet gets airborne far more easily than an airliner.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic description points at the Rhino tank: get inside one and survive the mayhem that follows. Tanks roll out at military sites once a high wanted level draws them in, or sit stored at the base — hijack one, cause enough damage from inside it, and the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at night, keep your weapon holstered until the till is open, watch the detection meter, and leave through the back. If you are spotted, abandon the attempt and retry — a detected robbery does not count even if you escape with the goods.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy scores marked at banks; bring armour, park a getaway car facing out, and expect a 4–5 star escape. Each bank counts once, so rotate through five different branches.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run fixed routes — ambush one away from police patrols, blow the rear doors, grab the cash and swap vehicles quickly, because your wanted level spikes. One successful truck job earns it, and failed attempts can simply be retried on the next route.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every district of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Exploration registers by travelling through an area, so one long road trip plus boat runs along the coast clears most of it; afterwards, check the map for fogged corners and mop those up individually.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation run by each gang. Every gang fronts at least one illegal business; hit one per gang rather than the same gang repeatedly. Operations are marked once scouted, and the gang colours on the map tell you whose is whose.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: find the beachfront bar on the Ocean Beach strip and order a drink there as either protagonist. It is a pure ambience trophy — no cost beyond the drink, no time pressure — and it can be done on your very first visit to the beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom through its glass front, in classic style: steal a car inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the windows. The downtown dealerships with full-glass fronts work best; the trophy registers as you exit through the glass, wanted level and all.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — visit the alley and complete a game of bowling there. It is a leisure stop, not a skill test: finishing the game is what counts, win or lose, so treat it as a breather between bigger grinds.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately cryptic: this one is tied to you and your partner performing together at a high standard. Play partner activities as a pair and aim for top results; it tends to unlock alongside the other partner trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy, so earn those first if this one has not popped.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy: at one of the campaign's major decision points, the game records what you chose, and this unlocks once the choice is made and its consequence plays out. The choice itself is mandatory, so there is nothing extra to hunt — keep playing the story and it resolves on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail once, then succeed: this unlocks when you retry something after a failure and pull it off — most reliably a story mission or challenge you failed on the first attempt. If it never pops naturally, deliberately fail a short challenge, then complete it on the immediate retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Leonida's weird-event trophy: witness one of the state's scripted strange encounters — the lights over the wetlands that players report at night. Head into the swamps after midnight and watch for the event to trigger; when the encounter plays out and ends, the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Score a strike: knock down ten people in a single melee drive-by, swinging a melee weapon from a moving motorcycle or car as you pass a crowd. A busy beach boardwalk or the queue outside a club gives you the density; one clean pass through ten targets is what registers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw, and the laundered total accumulates. Big late-game heists move this fastest — feed every Marked Bill you find into the laundry.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles and tuning all feed the one total. There is no reason to grind this early: endgame income dwarfs the target, so let it complete naturally while you kit out both protagonists, and only top it up with a spree if it lags behind.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on the market. Garages unlock for purchase as the story progresses and your funds grow; buy them as they appear instead of saving for one spree, because owning them early also helps vehicle storage while you work on Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you own or steal can be registered through the phone app; register your regular rides first, then fill the remaining slots with distinctive finds so the registered garage doubles as a collection.
